veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.na: om slym in op te hoes
veranderings.rede: Phlegm is coughed up ('ophoes'); 'slym in te hoes' reads as coughing into the bottle without bringing anything up.

veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.voor: en die hoes was nou al meer as twee weke daar
veranderings.na: en die hoes was toe al meer as twee weke daar
veranderings.rede: In past-tense narration by the narrator, 'toe al' marks the time of the story more cleanly than 'nou al'.

veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.rede: Ticking off days on a calendar is 'afmerk' in Afrikaans; 'merk' alone is less idiomatic.

veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.rede: Same idiom as the calendar sentence earlier: a block on a calendar is 'afgemerk'.

veranderings.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
veranderings.na: en hy het weer begin eet
veranderings.rede: After his food stayed on the plate, 'weer begin eet' says naturally that his appetite returned; 'weer geëet' reads like a single meal.
